hooks.command: { echo "[Claude Code SessionStart hook — auto-loads MILESTONES.md head per ADR-009 Decision 6 (compact-ledger auto-load model)]"; echo ""; echo "Before responding to the user's first message: read the MILESTONES.md head (auto-loaded below). Cross-check against main: 'git worktree list', 'git log --all --not main --oneline', 'git status'. Summarize in 4-6 lines: current phase + step, active feature (if any), recent activity, what is the immediate next deliverable. Surface any unmerged-branch deltas as a separate 'discrepancies' list — do NOT fold them into the main-anchored summary (per memory feedback_main_anchored_orient)."; echo ""; echo "Phase-transition check: if MILESTONES.md's Current Phase block shows the phase as complete with a next phase ready to enter, append a one-liner: 'Phase transition pending — see docs/handoff-prompts.md (## Phase-transition prompt). Invoke when ready.'"; echo ""; echo "Deeper context is consult-on-demand: WORKFLOW.md (conventions), DECISIONS.md (ADRs), CHANGELOG.md (per-version PR history), docs/PRD/ + docs/ARCH/ + docs/SECURITY/ (artifact detail). Do NOT auto-read these unless the user's question requires them."; echo ""; echo "--- MILESTONES.md (head section; auto-loaded) ---"; echo ""; awk '/^## Roadmap/{exit} {print}' MILESTONES.md; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: .}}'
